nodes.label: Pomotroid product overview
nodes.description: Configurable Pomodoro desktop timer, session history daily/weekly/all-time heatmap, custom audio, shortcuts, tray, compact mode, optional WebSocket integration.

nodes.label: Deliberate two-way emergency exit specification
nodes.description: Continuous 60s hold resets on release/focus loss; Rust monotonic authority with max 1s pulse jitter; or minimum 30 character salted Argon2id passphrase entered twice with 120s confirmation token.

nodes.label: Emergency Exit dialog and shortcut isolation
nodes.description: Dialog holds button/Space continuously 60s with progress or confirms passphrase twice; local Space cannot toggle timer during dialog. Header records implementation/type-check, not native interaction validation.
nodes.norm_label: emergency exit dialog and shortcut isolation

nodes.label: Domain normalization and passphrase security
nodes.description: Domain rules strip scheme/path/query/www, lowercase and IDNA; reject local/IP/malformed domains. Argon2id minimum 30 characters, m=19456,t=2,p=1. Header records normalization/duration/security unit tests passed.

nodes.label: Rust focus enforcement authority
nodes.description: Focus backend owns profile validation, state transitions, timer control interception and blocking. Typed IPC frontend renders snapshots and controls only.
nodes.rationale: Prevent bypass through shortcuts, tray or direct IPC; block before first work tick and before work resumes after break.

nodes.label: Replaced Electron/Vue implementation

nodes.label: Native enforcement coverage and remaining checks
nodes.description: Hosts-file blocking cannot establish encrypted-DNS or established-socket coverage. Privileged runtime checks require authorization. Native timer-window, other-platform E2E, and real Zen/Firefox installed-extension enforcement verification remain outstanding.
nodes.norm_label: native enforcement coverage and remaining checks

nodes.label: Focus lifecycle state machine and escape
nodes.description: Idle/Preparing/Active/Releasing/RecoveryRequired and Work/ShortBreak/LongBreak; locked run may unblock during breaks; finite cycle returns idle/unblocked. Header records state and two-step escape/hold tests passed.

nodes.label: Firefox and Zen use the same XPI package
nodes.norm_label: firefox and zen use the same xpi package
nodes.rationale: Installation searches resolved distribution root/firefox/focus@pomotroid.local.xpi then root/focus@pomotroid.local.xpi. Finding a file only precedes enterprise-policy writing; it does not prove the browser loaded it.

nodes.label: Mozilla force-installed policy uses local package file URL
nodes.norm_label: mozilla force-installed policy uses local package file url
nodes.rationale: Firefox and Zen share ExtensionSettings key focus@pomotroid.local, installation_mode force_installed and install_url pointing to the XPI file.

nodes.label: Resolve native host adjacent to app executable then resource root
nodes.norm_label: resolve native host adjacent to app executable then resource root
nodes.rationale: Chooses pomotroid-native-host(.exe) next to current_exe; if absent tries resource_dir/host_name, otherwise passes the absent adjacent path to registration. No other path, executable-permission or spawn probe is performed here.

nodes.label: Native host reads config file and returns token plus port
nodes.norm_label: native host reads config file and returns token plus port
nodes.rationale: The native host reads focus_browser_config.json at its platform-specific app-data path, requires a token, defaults port to 1421 and returns {type:config,token,port} only after receiving Connect.

nodes.label: Firefox and Zen share Mozilla native host manifest
nodes.norm_label: firefox and zen share mozilla native host manifest
nodes.rationale: A single per-user Mozilla NativeMessagingHosts/com.splode.pomotroid.json allows focus@pomotroid.local. Removing one Mozilla-family browser keeps the host if the other browser still has policy.

nodes.label: ACK and heartbeat revisions follow successful policy application
nodes.norm_label: ack and heartbeat revisions follow successful policy application
nodes.rationale: Only after rule update and tab query complete are currentRevision and lastAckedRevision advanced and ACK sent. Failure sends error instead; heartbeat reports lastAckedRevision every two seconds.

nodes.label: Authenticated loopback WebSocket hello includes browser identity
nodes.norm_label: authenticated loopback websocket hello includes browser identity
nodes.rationale: Connect requires stored token and profile_id, opens ws://127.0.0.1:<port>/focus-browser and sends version:1 hello with browser kind, install_type and may_disable; management API fallback is development/may_disable:true.

nodes.label: Apply policy through declarativeNetRequest dynamic rules
nodes.norm_label: apply policy through declarativenetrequest dynamic rules
nodes.rationale: Policy messages replace existing dynamic rules using rulesForPolicy; matching open tabs are redirected to blocked.html. Inactive/empty policy clears dynamic rules. Errors emit a revision/profile error message.

nodes.label: Mozilla identity chooses Zen markers then Firefox fallback
nodes.norm_label: mozilla identity chooses zen markers then firefox fallback
nodes.rationale: moz-extension URL selects Mozilla-family handling; getBrowserInfo().zen object or a Zen marker in UA/brands identifies Zen. Missing markers or API error falls back to firefox.

nodes.label: Native pairing persists token port and profile identity
nodes.norm_label: native pairing persists token port and profile identity
nodes.rationale: Retains existing profile_id or creates a random one, persists token/port/profile_id/is_native_paired, then resolves true. On storage failure resolves false and emits storage_write_failed.

nodes.label: Policy-backed flag selects Install or Remove button
nodes.norm_label: policy-backed flag selects install or remove button
nodes.rationale: The button uses browser.is_extension_installed; the connected profiles section separately uses prof.is_connected. Installation success appears after registration and policy writing resolve.

nodes.label: Extension-installed flag reflects policy presence only
nodes.norm_label: extension-installed flag reflects policy presence only
nodes.rationale: is_extension_installed comes from is_policy_installed_at_path; this does not probe browser extension activation, native messaging, WebSocket connection, rules or ACK.

nodes.label: Mozilla policy presence check
nodes.rationale: Firefox and Zen return true when policies.ExtensionSettings[focus@pomotroid.local] is an object; installation_mode, install_url, package validity and browser runtime are not verified here.

nodes.label: Bootstrap awaits native pairing before WebSocket connect
nodes.norm_label: bootstrap awaits native pairing before websocket connect
nodes.rationale: Whenever connectNative exists, bootstrap awaits tryNativePairing before connect reads stored credentials. Runtime startup/installation and module initialization trigger bootstrap; other reconnect triggers can call connect directly.

nodes.label: Native pairing requests com.splode.pomotroid config
nodes.rationale: connectNative opens com.splode.pomotroid then posts {type:connect}; listener resolves on config with token or on disconnect/exception. No timeout is installed in this promise.

nodes.label: Browser companion enforcement
nodes.description: Browser-native website blocking avoids root privileges, VPN tunnel and paid Apple signing; build extensions then pair using Sessions token.

nodes.label: Temporary Firefox and Safari limits
nodes.description: Firefox temporary unsigned XPI is removed by browser restart; release persistent install needs AMO signing; policy alone does not prove loading. Safari temporary unsigned extensions need reenabling after restart.

nodes.label: Stable unpacked Chrome identity
nodes.description: Fixed extension ID ddiojihepmbimcfoefnebpolgaljlcfn; upgrade requires replacing old extension, re-pairing/updating profile and registering native host allowed origin. Published store build needs managed signing identity.

nodes.label: Managed browser force-install policies
nodes.description: Ordinary extensions cannot prevent removal; administrators can deploy managed Chrome/Firefox force_installed policies; Firefox release signing still required.

nodes.label: Pairing diagnostic privacy
nodes.description: Verbose Logging and browser diagnostic stages support troubleshooting; review private data and never share pairing tokens indiscriminately.
